dedupe_keys.name: vector dataset of bus networks across 299 chinese cities 2024

description: This dataset gives vector data on the bus networks of 299 cities in mainland China up to April 2024 (Taiwan Province is not included). For each city it contains bus stops and bus routes, with directed and undirected versions of the routes, and a topological network of nodes and undirected edges. The authors generated it from electronic map APIs with algorithms for coordinate transformation, network simplification, station projection and topology generation, and cross-validated the results; Chinese names were translated into English with a machine translation API. Coverage is national across 299 cities. The data are available to download from Figshare as a single zipped set of shapefiles (about 1.2 GB) under CC BY, and the article in Scientific Data (2025) describes the methods; the processing code is released with the data. Caveats: the data derive from commercial map services whose terms and availability can change (the authors note that one provider suspended its service in March 2025), the translation is automatic, and there are no timetables or ridership. The networks support topology, accessibility and resilience analyses of urban bus systems and international comparison. The dataset is related to the China Public Transport Operation Network Dataset (CPTOND-2025), which adds metro lines.
